title: kbroot.py fetch --hook leaves the git transport process running after its time bound
goal: When a fetch root's git command runs past its bound, kbroot.py kills the whole process group of that git command (its ssh or remote helper too), so no transport process outlives fetch --hook, fetch or push (found by the SP-mguax5m3 review: a GIT_SSH_COMMAND child stayed with ppid 1)
